error.api_error_no_details: An error occurred while communicating with the Proxmox VE instance.
error.cannot_connect: Cannot connect to Proxmox VE server
error.enrollment_too_large: The enrollment value is too large. Paste only the single HUBINET1 value printed by bootstrap.
error.invalid_enrollment_base64: The enrollment encoding is malformed. Paste the complete HUBINET1 value without changing it.
error.invalid_enrollment_host_key: The enrollment contains an invalid or ambiguous PVE SSH host key. Re-run bootstrap on the PVE host.
error.invalid_enrollment_json: The enrollment payload is malformed. Paste the complete HUBINET1 value printed by bootstrap.
error.invalid_enrollment_prefix: The enrollment prefix or version is unsupported. Run the bootstrap command shown by this Hubinet-Ops version.
error.invalid_enrollment_private_key: The enrollment contains an invalid SSH private key. Re-run bootstrap to create new credentials.
error.invalid_enrollment_schema: The enrollment fields are invalid. Use only the value printed by the displayed bootstrap command.
error.invalid_enrollment_token: The enrollment contains an invalid API token secret. Re-run bootstrap to create new credentials.
error.ssh_auth_failed: SSH authentication failed. Re-run the bootstrap with --reset and paste the new enrollment value.
error.ssh_cannot_connect: Cannot connect to PVE SSH on port 22. Check the host and SSH service.
error.ssh_host_key_mismatch: The PVE SSH host key does not match the enrolled key. Verify the host and re-run bootstrap on that host.
error.helper_missing_or_outdated: The PVE helper is missing or outdated. Re-run the displayed bootstrap command.
error.helper_protocol_mismatch: The PVE helper protocol is incompatible with this Hubinet-Ops version. Re-run the displayed bootstrap command.
error.package_node_not_found: The authenticated SSH host's local PVE node was not found through the Proxmox API. Check that the API and SSH host are the same cluster.
error.no_nodes_found: No active nodes were found on the Proxmox VE server.
error.no_vmlxc_found: No LXC or VM were found on the Proxmox VE server.

enrollment.description:
Run this command once as root on the Proxmox VE host:

```text
{bootstrap_command}
```

Then paste the enrollment value below. Hubinet-Ops validates the API, SSH host key, SSH authentication, helper protocol, and local node before saving.
enrollment.title: Enroll Hubinet-Ops

confirm_package_review.name: Confirm package review
confirm_package_review.description: Confirms the exact package plan previously returned by Get package plan as reviewed, if it is still the current one. The token is not a password; it only proves the plan being confirmed is still the one shown, not a newer or different scan.

token.name: Token
token.description: The token returned alongside the plan by Get package plan. Confirmation is rejected, without raising an error, if a new scan has since replaced it.

get_package_plan.name: Get package plan
get_package_plan.description: Returns the latest scan status for one LXC, and for a successful scan, its exact pending-package plan and a token to confirm it with. Never starts a scan and never changes review state.
